svg.text: THE INTRO ON THE CLOCK OF INT 1CH: 2,723 TICKS (149 S IN THE ORACLE WITH ADLIB)
top of the scale: 210 writes in a second
Sound events are the QueueSound calls of an oracle run (INTRO.EXE '3 1 0 homie'). Piece 2's end is where its register writes stop in that run; the oracle
charges for every status-port read, so its music runs about 14 percent slower than the script timing says (76 s, 5.14.3).
